Fido got up, stretched himself, and, coming to my side, resting his paws upon the volume, turned over a few leaves, quietly resumed his former place, and then began to think again. The operation was twice repeated, and, at the third time, I thought, I could perceive, in his intelligent looks, an expression of satisfaction, that he, at least, had mastered a page of the book.
